entity.name: Sean Leonard
entity.description: Software engineer who builds SlicerX, an open source 3D printing slicer and CAD engine.

projects.name: SlicerX
projects.description: A free, open source slicer for 3D printers with its own Rust engine and a mesh CAD layer. It gives the same G-code natively and in the browser, prints to printers on the local network with no account, and exposes a CLI, a C library, a WebAssembly package and an MCP server so other software can drive it.

channels.description: GitHub Sponsors, no fees for personal accounts.

plans.name: Printer hardware testing
plans.description: Buy and run test printers from each supported family (Prusa, Klipper printers, Snapmaker, Elegoo, Bambu Lab H2 series) so every profile and connector is checked with real prints before release.

plans.name: Maintainer time
plans.description: Pay for focused maintenance time: releases for macOS, Windows, Linux and the browser, bug fixes, security fixes, reviews and documentation.
